content.comment_body: Hello, I want to configure the RTC time to UTC+3:30, but the options only allow +3 or +4. Thank you.

This thread was closed because the same question was posted elsewhere. The other thread addressing the RTC time zone change was published in the [product_name] - Software section. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: The user cannot set the RTC (Real Time Clock) time zone to an offset with half-hour increments (like +3:30) because the [product_name] interface only supports full-hour values (+3, +4). This highlights an issue with the time zone settings, limiting use in regions requiring more precise offsets and demonstrating a need for better localization support.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the RTC time zone configuration to allow UTC+3:30 to accurately reflect the local time. The interface should provide options for more detailed time zone settings, including half-hour intervals.
